title: From Statistical Inference to Learning Methods
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with UNSTIM, Benin
about: CIMPA research school in Abomey, Benin, 15-26 March 2027, covering classical inference, stochastic modelling and supervised and unsupervised learning, with R or Python and finance and risk applications. Applications close 15 November 2026.
requirements: CIMPA schools are aimed mainly at students and teacher-researchers in developing countries
Courses are at least Master's level
Applications must be made via the CIMPA application site before the deadline on the school's page

upskill.name: Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I
why: Skill "Statistical inference" → objective "Apply inferential statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and analysis of variance (ANOVA), to draw conclusions from samples."

Field "Statistics and machine learning" (classical inference, stochastic modelling) → objective "Introduce Bayesian statistics and probabilistic modelling as approaches for representing uncertainty and updating analytical conclusions as new evidence becomes available."
